name: read-one-file
prompt: Read internal/daemon/daemon.go with the Read tool and reply with only its line count. Use no other tool.

name: reread-same-file
prompt: Read internal/daemon/daemon.go with the Read tool, then read it a second time, then reply with only its line count. Use no other tool.

name: bash-git-log
prompt: Run `git log --oneline -30` with the Bash tool and reply with only the newest commit's subject line. Use no other tool.

name: cat-n-dump
prompt: Run `cat -n internal/hookcore/memstore.go` with the Bash tool and reply with only the name of the last function defined in it. Use no other tool.

name: grep-symbol
prompt: Use the Grep tool to find every definition matching 'func Thin' under internal/detect, then reply with only the matching file names. Use no other tool.
